name: io.github.Packrift/packrift-mcp
title: Packrift MCP
description: Exact-spec Packrift packaging search with live price, stock, shipping, cart handoff, and no-match.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_PACKRIFT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional for MCP introspection and directory scanning. Required only when self-hosting live Shopify-backed catalog, pricing, inventory, shipping, and cart tools. The public hosted endpoint at https://mcp.packrift.com/mcp needs no user-supplied token.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP port exposed by the Packrift MCP container.
